import re, os, sys, json
S = "."
# 1) collect tasklet callbacks: tasklet_setup(&X, cb) / tasklet_init(&X, cb, data)
cb_names = set()
files_with_tasklet = {}
pat_setup = re.compile(r'tasklet_setup\s*\(\s*&[^,]+,\s*([A-Za-z_0-9]+)\s*\)')
pat_init = re.compile(r'tasklet_init\s*\(\s*&[^,]+,\s*([A-Za-z_0-9]+)\s*,')
# DECLARE_TASKLET / DECLARE_TASKLET_OLD
pat_decl = re.compile(r'DECLARE_TASKLET(?:_OLD)?\s*\(\s*[^,]+,\s*([A-Za-z_0-9]+)\s*[,)]')

# 2) collect napi poll callbacks: netif_napi_add*(..., cb, ...) / netif_napi_add(dev, &x, cb[, weight])
pat_napi = re.compile(r'netif_napi_add(?:_weight|exclusive)?\s*\(\s*[^,]+,\s*&[^,]+,\s*([A-Za-z_0-9]+)\s*[,)]')

cbs = {}   # name -> (kind, file, line, reg_line)
for root, dirs, fl in os.walk(S):
    for f in fl:
        if not f.endswith(('.c', '.h')):
            continue
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        try:
            with open(p, 'r', errors='replace') as fh:
                lines = fh.readlines()
        except OSError:
            continue
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            for kind, pat in (('tasklet', pat_setup), ('tasklet', pat_init), ('tasklet', pat_decl), ('napi', pat_napi)):
                for m in pat.finditer(ln):
                    nm = m.group(1)
                    cbs.setdefault(nm, []).append((kind, p, i+1))
print("total callback names:", len(cbs))
json.dump({k: v for k, v in cbs.items()}, open('/tmp/i038_cbs.json', 'w'))
PYEOF
